bug_fix_applied.issue: Offline users onClick handler used setSelectedUserId() directly instead of handleSelectUser(), which meant clicking offline users on mobile didn't show the conversation view
bug_fix_applied.fix: Changed onClick={() => setSelectedUserId(user.id)} to onClick={() => handleSelectUser(user.id)}
